newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Gilt-Edged shares to list on Friday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Gilt-Edged shares to list on Friday.

text.p: Gilt-Edged Mining NL said on Monday its A$10 million share offer had closed heavily oversubscribed and it expected the shares to begin trading on the Australian Stock Exchange on December 20.
The company will have 66 million shares on issue, with 40 million offered to the public at 25 cents each, 24 million going to the vendor Robert Gardener, and two million to the seed financiers.
It said the funds raised would be used for exploration of two projects in the eastern goldfields region of Western Australian -- Siberia and Ora Banda/Christmas Reef.
Siberia is estimated to contain 243,000 ounces of gold at a grade of 2.8 g/t while the 520 ounce Evening Star nugget was found at Ora Banda four years ago.
